context: Falael is a female half-elf worker stationed outside the Baldur's Mouth office, not a guard but one of the busy locals in the courtyard. In the example she’s kneeling and inspecting something on the ground while nervously counting aloud, then stands and brusquely apologizes—“can’t chat”—to passing strangers. This is a brief, distracted one-liner meant to convey she’s occupied rather than inviting conversation, set among other short guard/gossiper lines around the building. Players may reply or interject (sometimes by echoing a number), but the line’s intent is simply to signal preoccupation.
